design: Safe, offline, artifact-based handoff between browser-side analysis (ChatGPT) and repo-side implementation. NO browser automation, NO network, NO API calls, NO credential/cookie storage, NO prompt execution (no exec/eval/subprocess/requests/urllib in the module). Functions: validate_analysis_request, create_analysis_request (writes a repo-relative request file; absolute/traversal rejected), prepare_next_chatgpt_instruction (deterministic), load/validate_analysis_artifact (non-raising; rejects wrong schema, missing required fields, empty prompt bodies, >10 recommended prompts, out-of-range score, unsafe paths/tags), evaluate_analysis_artifact (/100 breakdown), analysis_artifact_to_prompt_batch (writes path-safe prompt files INSIDE the batch dir + a Prompt655 manifest, then validates it with the Prompt655 validator).

safety.secret_path_handling: recommended prompt expected paths must be repo-relative safe; prompt files generated with safe names inside the batch dir

final_decision: Implemented the external analysis handoff controller: a safe, offline, artifact-based protocol that turns browser-side ChatGPT analysis into Prompt655-compatible prompt batches without any browser automation, network, credential storage, or arbitrary prompt execution. Analysis requests and artifacts are validated non-raising; a validated 'generate_prompt_batch' artifact is converted into path-safe prompt files inside a batch dir plus a manifest that passes the Prompt655 validator. 23 handoff tests + 154 total green; protected modules untouched; add_function/add_file and all existing layers preserved.
